title: The Tertiary Education, Placement and Funding Bill, 2026
stage: Before the National Assembly Education Committee, which is preparing its report for Second Reading. Public views closed 2 October 2026, 5pm

sources.label: Tertiary Education, Placement and Funding Bill, 2026 (as published, 24 Jul 2026)

text.en: The Bill creates two bodies: the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service, which places students and trainees in public tertiary institutions and runs career guidance, and the Tertiary Education Funding Authority, which raises money and gives education loans and scholarships. It sets up the Tertiary Education Fund to pay for the loans, says who can apply, and requires a loanee to start repaying within one year after finishing studies. Employers must deduct repayments from a loanee's pay and send them to the Authority within nine days after the month ends, and deductions are capped at 25% of the loanee's pay. An employer who is late in sending the money is charged 5% for each month or part of a month. The Bill repeals the Higher Education Loans Board Act and parts of the Universities Act and the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Act, and moves the property, liabilities and staff of the old boards to the two new bodies. It also changes the Limitation of Actions Act for civil cases to recover these loans.
text.sw: Mswada huu unaanzisha taasisi mbili: Huduma Kuu ya Kuwapanga Wanafunzi Vyuoni (Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service), inayowapanga wanafunzi na wanagenzi katika taasisi za umma za elimu ya juu na kutoa mwongozo wa taaluma, na Mamlaka ya Ufadhili wa Elimu ya Juu (Tertiary Education Funding Authority), inayokusanya fedha na kutoa mikopo na ufadhili wa masomo. Mswada unaanzisha Hazina ya Elimu ya Juu ya kulipia mikopo hiyo, unaeleza nani anaweza kuomba, na unamtaka mkopaji aanze kulipa ndani ya mwaka mmoja baada ya kumaliza masomo. Waajiri wanatakiwa kukata marejesho kutoka kwa malipo ya mkopaji na kuyawasilisha kwa Mamlaka ndani ya siku tisa baada ya mwezi kuisha, na makato hayawezi kuzidi 25% ya malipo ya mkopaji. Mwajiri anayechelewa kuwasilisha anatozwa 5% kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi. Mswada unafuta Sheria ya Bodi ya Mikopo ya Elimu ya Juu (Higher Education Loans Board Act) na sehemu za Sheria ya Vyuo Vikuu na Sheria ya Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi, na kuhamishia mali, madeni na wafanyakazi wa bodi za zamani kwa taasisi hizo mbili. Pia unabadilisha Sheria ya Ukomo wa Muda wa Kufungua Kesi (Limitation of Actions Act) kuhusu kesi za madai za kurejesha mikopo hii.
text.sheng: Bill hii ina-create two bodies: Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service, ambayo ina-place students na trainees kwa public tertiary institutions na ku-run career guidance, na Tertiary Education Funding Authority, ambayo ina-raise money na ku-give education loans na scholarships. Pia ina-set up Tertiary Education Fund ya ku-pay loans, ina-say who can apply, na loanee ana-start ku-repay loan within one year after ku-finish studies. Employers wana-deduct repayments from pay ya loanee na ku-remit kwa Authority within nine days after month ina-end, na deductions haziwezi ku-exceed 25% ya pay ya loanee. Employer akiwa late ku-remit, Authority ina-charge 5% kwa kila month ama part ya month. Bill ina-repeal Higher Education Loans Board Act na parts za Universities Act na TVET Act, na property, liabilities na staff wa old boards wana-move kwa two new bodies. Ina-also change Limitation of Actions Act kwa civil cases za loan recovery.

text.en: A loanee in formal employment must tell the employer about the loan when starting the job, and the employer must inform the Authority about the employment. The employer deducts the monthly repayment from the loanee's pay and sends it to the Authority within nine days after each month ends, and deductions are capped at 25% of the loanee's pay. Staff of the old boards are treated as staff of the Placement Service and the Authority.
text.sw: Mkopaji aliye katika ajira rasmi anatakiwa kumjulisha mwajiri kuhusu mkopo anapoanza kazi, na mwajiri anatakiwa kuijulisha Mamlaka kuhusu ajira hiyo. Mwajiri anakata marejesho ya kila mwezi kutoka kwa malipo ya mkopaji na kuyawasilisha kwa Mamlaka ndani ya siku tisa baada ya mwezi kuisha, na makato hayawezi kuzidi 25% ya malipo ya mkopaji. Wafanyakazi wa bodi za zamani wanachukuliwa kuwa wafanyakazi wa Huduma ya Kuwapanga Wanafunzi na wa Mamlaka.
text.sheng: Loanee kwa formal employment ana-disclose loan status kwa employer at the start ya job, na employer ana-inform Authority. Employer ana-deduct repayments from pay ya loanee na ku-remit within nine days after each month, na deductions haziwezi ku-exceed 25% ya pay ya loanee. Staff wa former institutions wanakuwa staff wa Placement Service na Authority.

text.en: A loanee in informal employment enters a payment plan with the Authority on how and how often they will pay. Repayment starts within one year after finishing studies, together with interest and any other charges. Deductions are capped at 25% of the loanee's pay.
text.sw: Mkopaji aliye katika ajira isiyo rasmi anaingia mpango wa malipo na Mamlaka kuhusu njia na mara ngapi atalipa. Ulipaji unaanza ndani ya mwaka mmoja baada ya kumaliza masomo, pamoja na riba na gharama nyingine zozote. Makato hayawezi kuzidi 25% ya malipo ya mkopaji.
text.sheng: Loanee kwa informal employment ana-enter payment plan na Authority on mode na frequency ya payment. Repayment ina-start within one year after ku-finish studies, together na interest na other charges. Deductions haziwezi ku-exceed 25% ya pay ya loanee.

text.en: The Placement Service places students who apply and qualify in public tertiary institutions, with set timelines for applications, a free chance to revise an unsuccessful application, and a second chance (with a fee) for those who did not apply. Kenyan students and trainees admitted to public or private tertiary institutions can apply to the Authority for education loans (an eligible person can apply for a minor), and funding under the Act is for students placed by the Placement Service. The Authority sets the interest rate for loans with the Cabinet Secretary and administers scholarships, and the Bill repeals the Higher Education Loans Board Act.
text.sw: Huduma ya Kuwapanga Wanafunzi inawapanga wanafunzi wanaoomba na kukidhi vigezo katika taasisi za umma za elimu ya juu, kukiwa na muda uliowekwa wa maombi, nafasi ya bure ya kurekebisha ombi lisilofaulu, na nafasi ya pili (kwa ada) kwa wasioomba mwanzoni. Wanafunzi na wanagenzi Wakenya waliokubaliwa katika taasisi za umma au za kibinafsi wanaweza kuomba mikopo ya elimu kwa Mamlaka (mtu anayestahili anaweza kuomba kwa niaba ya mtoto mdogo), na ufadhili chini ya Sheria hii ni wa wanafunzi waliopangwa na Huduma hiyo. Mamlaka inapanga kiwango cha riba ya mikopo pamoja na Waziri, inasimamia ufadhili wa masomo, na Mswada unafuta Sheria ya Bodi ya Mikopo ya Elimu ya Juu (Higher Education Loans Board Act).
text.sheng: Placement Service ina-place students ambao wana-apply na ku-qualify kwa public tertiary institutions, na iko na timelines za applications, free chance ya ku-revise application ikiwa unsuccessful, na second chance (kwa fee) kwa persons ambao hawakufanya application mwanzoni. Kenyan students na trainees admitted kwa public ama private tertiary institution wanaweza ku-apply kwa Authority for education loan, na eligible person anaweza ku-apply kwa minor, na funding under hii Act ni ya students ambao Placement Service ime-place. Authority ina-set interest rate for loans na Cabinet Secretary, ina-administer scholarships, na Bill ina-repeal Higher Education Loans Board Act.

clauses.heading: Short title and commencement.
clauses.text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Tertiary Education Placement and Funding Act, 2026.

explanation.en: Section 1 gives the law its official short name: the Tertiary Education Placement and Funding Act, 2026. It is a naming clause only, so it does not change anything for anyone.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 1 kinapa sheria hii jina lake rasmi fupi: Tertiary Education Placement and Funding Act, 2026. Kifungu hiki ni cha jina tu, kwa hivyo hakibadilishi chochote kwa mtu yeyote.
explanation.sheng: Section 1 ina-give hii Act official short title yake: Tertiary Education Placement and Funding Act, 2026. Ni clause ya title tu, haina-change kitu kwa any person.

neutral_check.note: Short title clause only; the explanation states the name and that nothing else changes, with no opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Interpretation.
clauses.text: 2. In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires– “accepting institution” means a tertiary institution that accepts a student who has been placed by the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service in a different tertiary institution during the inter institution transfers; “admission” means the process of accepting an applicant who meets the minimum requirements set by the relevant authorities for the programme applied for in a tertiary institution; “Authority” means the Tertiary Education Funding Authority established under section 28; “Cabinet Secretary” means the Cabinet Secretary for the time being responsible for matters relating to tertiary education; “Chief Executive Officer means the Chief Executive Officer of the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service or the Tertiary Education Funding Authority; “Commission” means the Commission for University Education established under section 4 of the Universities Act; “eligible person” means any person, who being a Kenyan citizen has attained a minimum entry requirement and has been admitted to a recognized tertiary institution or any other person being a Kenyan citizen, is willing to access tertiary education loan for the benefit of a student admitted in a tertiary institution; “emolument” means any salary, wages, remuneration, allowances, bonus, commission, gratuity, benefit or other payments or benefit whether in cash or in-kind payable to a beneficiary in respect to employment or services rendered; “enrolment” means the total number of students and trainees admitted in a tertiary institution to undertake a course or programme in a given period; “Fund” means the Tertiary Education Fund established under section 43; “loan” means financial aid granted to a student or a trainee undertaking tertiary education; “loanee” means a person who has received a loan facility for tertiary education; “placement” means allocating qualified students and trainees to specific programmes or courses in various tertiary institutions; “Placement Service” means the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service established under section 6; “regulatory bodies” means the Commission of University Education established under section 4 of the Universities Act and the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority established under section 6 of the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Act; “saving scheme” means a savings plan, specifically designed by the Tertiary Education Funding Authority to enable a person to plan or invest for the tertiary education of a student’s or trainee; “scholarship” means the financial aid awarded to student or trainee, based on their need to support tertiary education; “student” means any person undertaking tertiary education in a university; “tertiary education” means formal post-secondary education offered in a tertiary institution; “tertiary institution” means a university, college, and technical and vocational education training institution recognized by the relevant regulatory bodies; and “trainee” means any person undertaking tertiary education in a college.

explanation.en: This section is a definitions clause. It explains what key words mean in the rest of the Act. It covers the bodies and offices (the Authority, the Commission, the Placement Service, the Fund, the regulatory bodies, the Cabinet Secretary and the Chief Executive Officer) and the people involved: a student (in a university), a trainee (in a college), an eligible person (a Kenyan citizen admitted to a recognised tertiary institution, or a Kenyan citizen willing to take a loan for an admitted student), a loanee and an accepting institution. It also defines money and education terms: loan, scholarship (aid based on need), saving scheme, emolument (any pay or benefit for work, in cash or in kind), admission, placement, enrolment, tertiary education and tertiary institution (a university, college or technical and vocational training institution recognised by the regulators).
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki ni cha tafsiri. Kinaeleza maana ya maneno muhimu yanayotumika katika Sheria hii. Kinafafanua taasisi na ofisi (Mamlaka, Tume, Huduma ya Upangaji, Hazina, mashirika ya udhibiti, Waziri na Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji) na watu wanaohusika: mwanafunzi (wa chuo kikuu), mwanagenzi (wa chuo cha kati), mtu anayestahiki (raia wa Kenya aliyekubaliwa katika taasisi ya elimu ya juu inayotambuliwa, au raia wa Kenya aliye tayari kuchukua mkopo kwa niaba ya mwanafunzi aliyekubaliwa), mkopaji na taasisi inayokubali. Pia kinatoa maana ya istilahi za fedha na elimu: mkopo, udhamini wa masomo (msaada kulingana na mahitaji), mpango wa akiba, marupurupu (malipo au manufaa yoyote ya kazi, kwa pesa taslimu au kwa bidhaa), uandikishaji, upangaji, idadi ya waliosajiliwa, elimu ya juu na taasisi ya elimu ya juu (chuo kikuu, chuo, au taasisi ya mafunzo ya ufundi inayotambuliwa na mashirika ya udhibiti).
explanation.sheng: Section 2 ina-define meaning ya key words ambazo zinatumika kwa hii Act. Ina-cover bodies kama Authority, Commission, Placement Service, Fund na regulatory bodies, na Cabinet Secretary na Chief Executive Officer. Pia ina-define people kama student (university), trainee (college), eligible person (Kenyan citizen admitted kwa recognised tertiary institution ama Kenyan citizen ambaye anataka loan ya student), loanee na accepting institution, na money na education terms kama loan, scholarship (support based on need), saving scheme, emolument (pay yoyote ama benefit ya work, cash ama in-kind), admission, placement, enrolment, tertiary education na tertiary institution.

neutral_check.note: Definitions clause, described as written with no opinion, advice or judgement on legality.

clauses.heading: Objects of the Act.
clauses.text: 3. The object of this Act shall be to provide a framework for— (a) the placement of students and trainees to tertiary institutions; (b) financing students and trainees undertaking tertiary education; and (c) offering coordinated career guidance to students and trainees.

explanation.en: Section 3 states the purpose of the Act. It says the Act is meant to provide a framework for three things: placing students and trainees in tertiary institutions (colleges and universities), financing students and trainees who are doing tertiary education, and offering career guidance that is coordinated. This section does not itself set any rule, amount or deadline.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 3 kinaeleza lengo la Sheria hii. Kinasema Sheria hii inalenga kutoa mfumo wa kuwapanga wanafunzi na wanagenzi katika taasisi za elimu ya juu, kufadhili wanafunzi na wanagenzi wanaosoma elimu ya juu, na kutoa ushauri wa kazi ulioratibiwa. Kifungu hiki chenyewe hakiweki kanuni, kiasi cha pesa wala tarehe ya mwisho.
explanation.sheng: Section 3 ina-say purpose ya hii Act ni ku-set up framework ya placement ya students na trainees kwa tertiary institutions, financing ya students na trainees wanaofanya tertiary education, na coordinated career guidance kwa students na trainees. Hii section yenyewe haiweki rule, amount ama deadline.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the stated purposes of the Act, with no opinion, advice or judgement on legality.

clauses.heading: Guiding Principles.
clauses.text: 4. The implementation of this Act shall ensure— (a) universal access to tertiary education; (b) equal access to government funding; (c) availability of adequate funds through promotion of diversified funding sources; (d) sustainable source of funding; and (e) prudent utilization of funds.

explanation.en: Section 4 lists five principles that are to guide how this Act is carried out. They are: access to tertiary education (college and university) for everyone, equal access to government funding, enough money made available by drawing on different sources of funding, a funding source that lasts over time, and careful use of the funds.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 4 kinaweka kanuni tano zitakazoongoza utekelezaji wa Sheria hii. Kanuni hizo ni: upatikanaji wa elimu ya juu (vyuo na vyuo vikuu) kwa wote, ufikiaji sawa wa ufadhili wa serikali, upatikanaji wa fedha za kutosha kupitia vyanzo mbalimbali vya ufadhili, chanzo cha ufadhili kinachodumu, na matumizi makini ya fedha.
explanation.sheng: Section 4 ina-set five principles za ku-guide how hii Act ina-work. First ni access kwa tertiary education (college na university) kwa everyone, na second ni equal access kwa government funding. Zingine ni enough funds kutoka different sources, funding ambayo ina-last, na careful use ya funds.

neutral_check.note: Describes the five listed principles in plain words, with no opinion on them and no advice.

clauses.heading: Application.
clauses.text: 5. This Act shall apply to– (a) persons seeking placement in tertiary institutions; (b) students or trainees seeking funding for tertiary education; (c) students or trainees granted funding for tertiary education; (d) Kenyan students and trainees pursuing tertiary education within and outside Kenya; (e) accredited tertiary institutions offering tertiary education in Kenya; and (f) any person or institution interested in funding in tertiary education.

explanation.en: This section says who the Act covers. It applies to people seeking a place in a tertiary institution, to students and trainees who are seeking funding or have been granted it, and to Kenyan students and trainees studying in Kenya or abroad. It also applies to accredited tertiary institutions in Kenya, and to any person or institution interested in funding tertiary education.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaeleza Sheria hii inawahusu nani. Inawahusu watu wanaotafuta nafasi katika taasisi za elimu ya juu, wanafunzi na wanagenzi wanaotafuta ufadhili au waliopewa ufadhili, na wanafunzi na wanagenzi Wakenya wanaosoma ndani au nje ya Kenya. Pia inahusu taasisi za elimu ya juu zilizoidhinishwa nchini Kenya, na mtu au taasisi yoyote inayopenda kufadhili elimu ya juu.
explanation.sheng: Section 5 ina-say hii Act ina-apply kwa nani. Ina-cover persons wanaotafuta placement kwa tertiary institutions, students na trainees wanaotafuta funding ama ambao wamepewa funding, na Kenyan students na trainees wanaosoma inside ama outside Kenya. Pia ina-cover accredited tertiary institutions za Kenya, na any person ama institution ambayo ina-want ku-fund tertiary education.

neutral_check.note: Section only lists who the Act applies to, so it was described without opinion, advice or any view on legality.

clauses.heading: Establishment of the Placement Service.
clauses.text: 6. (1) There is established a Placement Service to be known as the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service. (2) The Placement Service shall be a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal and shall, in its corporate name, be capable of— (a) suing and being sued; (b) taking, purchasing, or otherwise acquiring, holding, charging, leasing, or disposing of moveable or immovable property; (c) borrowing and lending money; (d) doing or performing all such other acts necessary for the proper performance of its functions under this Act which may lawfully be done or performed by a body corporate. (3) The headquarters of the Placement Service shall be in Nairobi, but the Service shall ensure access to its services in all parts of Kenya.

explanation.en: This section creates a new body called the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service. It is a body corporate, meaning it is a legal entity in its own name that continues to exist whoever runs it. In that name it can sue and be sued, own, lease or sell property, and borrow and lend money. Its headquarters are in Nairobi, and it must make its services accessible in all parts of Kenya.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaanzisha chombo kipya kinachoitwa Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service. Huduma hii ni shirika lenye hadhi ya kisheria kwa jina lake, yaani inaweza kushtaki na kushtakiwa, kumiliki, kukodisha au kuuza mali, na kukopa na kukopesha pesa. Makao makuu yake yatakuwa Nairobi, lakini huduma zake lazima zipatikane kila pembe ya Kenya.
explanation.sheng: Section 6 ina-establish new body ambayo itaitwa Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service. Hii body ni body corporate, ambayo inamaanisha iko na own legal identity: inaweza ku-sue na ku-be sued, ku-own, lease ama sell property, na ku-borrow na ku-lend money. Headquarters ziko Nairobi, lakini Service lazima i-ensure services zake ziko accessible kote Kenya.

neutral_check.note: Section only sets up a body corporate, its powers and its headquarters, so it was described without opinion, advice or any view on legality.

clauses.heading: Functions of the Placement Service.
clauses.text: 7. The Placement Service shall— (a) set a framework to facilitate placement of students and trainees in tertiary education institutions; (b) place students and trainees to public accredited tertiary institutions; (c) offer coordinated career guidance to persons intending to pursue tertiary education; (d) establish and maintain a system for data management relating to placement of students for tertiary education; (e) advise the Cabinet Secretary on matters relating to placement of students and trainees; and (f) perform any other function conferred on it by this Act or any other written law.

explanation.en: This section lists what the Placement Service does. It sets a framework for placing students and trainees in tertiary education institutions, and it places students and trainees in public accredited tertiary institutions. It also offers coordinated career guidance to people who plan to go into tertiary education, and sets up and keeps a data system on the placement of students. It advises the Cabinet Secretary on placement matters, and carries out any other function given to it by this Act or another written law.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaorodhesha kazi za Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service). Huduma hii inaweka mfumo wa kupanga wanafunzi na wafunzwa katika taasisi za elimu ya juu, na inawapanga katika taasisi za umma za elimu ya juu zilizoidhinishwa. Pia inatoa ushauri ulioratibiwa wa taaluma kwa watu wanaokusudia kujiunga na elimu ya juu, na inaanzisha na kudumisha mfumo wa kusimamia data ya upangaji wa wanafunzi. Aidha, inamshauri Waziri (Cabinet Secretary) kuhusu masuala ya upangaji, na inatekeleza kazi nyingine yoyote iliyotolewa na Sheria hii au sheria nyingine iliyoandikwa.
explanation.sheng: Section 7 ina-list functions za Placement Service. Placement Service ina-set framework ya placement ya students na trainees kwenye tertiary education institutions, na ina-place students na trainees kwa public accredited tertiary institutions. Pia ina-offer coordinated career guidance kwa persons ambao wanataka ku-pursue tertiary education, ina-set up na ku-maintain system ya data management ya placement ya students, na ina-advise Cabinet Secretary on matters za placement. Pia ina-perform any other function ambayo hii Act ama any other written law ina-give.

neutral_check.note: Section only lists the Placement Service's functions; explained item by item with no opinion, advice or legal judgement.

clauses.heading: Powers of the Placement Service.
clauses.text: 8. In performance of the functions under section 7, the Placement Service shall have powers to– (a) administer the assets of the Placement Service; (b) open and operate bank accounts in accordance with the relevant laws; (c) receive any gifts, grants, donations, endowments, or any other monies lawfully received by the Placement Service; and (d) enter into associations, collaborations and linkages with other persons, bodies, or organizations within or outside Kenya, as the Placement Service may consider appropriate.

explanation.en: This section lists four powers the Placement Service has so it can carry out its functions under section 7. It can look after its own assets, open and run bank accounts as the relevant laws allow, and receive gifts, grants, donations, endowments and other money it receives lawfully. It can also form associations, collaborations and linkages with other persons, bodies or organizations, inside or outside Kenya, when it considers that appropriate.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaorodhesha mamlaka manne ambayo Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service) inayo katika kutekeleza majukumu yake chini ya kifungu cha 7. Inaweza kusimamia mali zake, kufungua na kuendesha akaunti za benki kwa mujibu wa sheria husika, na kupokea zawadi, ruzuku, michango, hazina za msaada na fedha nyingine zilizopokelewa kisheria. Pia inaweza kuingia katika ushirikiano na uhusiano na watu, taasisi au mashirika ndani au nje ya Kenya, inapoona inafaa.
explanation.sheng: Section 8 ina-list four powers za Placement Service ili iweze kufanya functions zake under section 7. Inaweza ku-administer assets zake, ku-open na ku-operate bank accounts kwa kufuata relevant laws, na ku-receive gifts, grants, donations, endowments na money nyingine ambayo ime-receivewa lawfully. Pia inaweza ku-enter into associations, collaborations na linkages na persons, bodies ama organizations inside ama outside Kenya, kama Placement Service ina-consider ni appropriate.

neutral_check.note: The section only lists the powers of a public body, so the explanation just describes each power without opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Board of the Placement Service.
clauses.text: 9. (1) There shall be a Board of the Placement Service which shall consist of— (a) a Chairperson, who shall be appointed by the President; (b) the Principal Secretary responsible for matters relating to university education or a designated representative; (c) the Principal Secretary responsible for matters relating to technical and vocational education and training or a designated representative; (d) the Principal Secretary responsible for matters relating to finance or a designated representative; (e) the Attorney-General or designated representative; (f) four independent persons; and (g) the Chief Executive Officer who shall be an ex officio member with no voting rights. (2) The members of the Board appointed under subsection (1) (f) shall be appointed by the Cabinet Secretary by notice in the Gazette. (3) The Chairperson and members of the Board appointed under subsection (1)(a) and (f) shall hold office for a term of three years and shall be eligible for reappointment for one further term subject to satisfactory performance.

explanation.en: Section 9 sets up a Board to run the Placement Service. The Board has a Chairperson appointed by the President, the Principal Secretaries for university education, technical and vocational education and training, and finance, the Attorney-General (each of whom may send a designated representative), and four independent persons. The Chief Executive Officer sits on the Board but has no vote. The Cabinet Secretary appoints the four independent persons by notice in the Gazette, and the Chairperson and the independent persons serve three years, with one possible further term if their performance is satisfactory.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 9 kinaunda Bodi ya Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service). Bodi hiyo ina Mwenyekiti anayeteuliwa na Rais, Makatibu Wakuu wa elimu ya chuo kikuu, mafunzo ya ufundi na kitaaluma (TVET) na fedha, pamoja na Mwanasheria Mkuu (kila mmoja anaweza kutuma mwakilishi aliyeteuliwa), na watu wanne huru. Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji ni mwanachama wa Bodi lakini hana haki ya kupiga kura. Waziri huteua wanachama hao wanne huru kwa notisi katika Gazeti la Serikali, na Mwenyekiti na wanachama huru hukaa madarakani kwa miaka mitatu, wakiweza kuteuliwa tena mara moja kama utendaji wao unaridhisha.
explanation.sheng: Section 9 ina-create Board ya Placement Service. Board iko na Chairperson ambaye President ana-appoint, Principal Secretaries wa university education, TVET na finance, Attorney-General, na four independent persons. Kila Principal Secretary na Attorney-General wanaweza kutuma designated representative. Chief Executive Officer ni member wa Board lakini hana vote. Cabinet Secretary ana-appoint hao four independent persons kwa notice kwenye Gazette, na Chairperson na hao independent persons wana-serve three years, na wanaweza kupewa one more term kama performance yao ni satisfactory.

neutral_check.note: Describes only who sits on the Board, who appoints them and their terms, with no opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Qualifications of the Chairperson of the Board of the Placement Service.
clauses.text: 10. A person qualifies to be appointed as the Chairperson of the Board under section 9 (1) (a), if the person— (a) is a citizen of Kenya; (b) holds a degree from a university recognized in Kenya; (c) has at least ten years’ experience in law, education, public administration, business management, financial management, governance or other relevant professional experience; and (d) meets the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution.

explanation.en: Section 10 lists who can be appointed Chairperson of the Board of the Placement Service under section 9 (1) (a). The person must be a Kenyan citizen, hold a degree from a university recognized in Kenya, and have at least ten years' experience in law, education, public administration, business management, financial management, governance or other relevant professional work. The person must also meet the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution (leadership and integrity).
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 10 kinaeleza sifa za mtu anayeweza kuteuliwa kuwa Mwenyekiti wa Bodi ya Placement Service chini ya kifungu cha 9 (1) (a). Mtu huyo lazima awe raia wa Kenya, awe na shahada kutoka chuo kikuu kinachotambuliwa nchini Kenya, na awe na uzoefu wa angalau miaka kumi katika sheria, elimu, utawala wa umma, usimamizi wa biashara, usimamizi wa fedha, uongozi au taaluma nyingine husika. Pia anapaswa kukidhi masharti ya Sura ya Sita ya Katiba (uongozi na uadilifu).
explanation.sheng: Section 10 ina-set qualifications za person ambaye ana-qualify ku-be appointed kama Chairperson wa Board ya Placement Service chini ya section 9 (1) (a). Person huyo ni citizen wa Kenya, ana degree kutoka university recognized in Kenya, na ana at least ten years experience kwa law, education, public administration, business management, financial management, governance ama other relevant professional work. Pia anapaswa a-meet requirements za Chapter Six ya Constitution, ambayo ni ya leadership na integrity.

neutral_check.note: Section only lists appointment qualifications for a board chairperson; described as written, with no opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Qualification of a member of the Board of the Placement Service.
clauses.text: 11. A person qualifies to be appointed as a member of the Board under section 9(1)(f) if the person— (a) is a citizen of Kenya; (b) holds a degree from a university recognized in Kenya; (c) has at least six years’ experience in business, financial management, governance or other relevant professional experience; and (d) meets the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution.

explanation.en: Section 11 sets out who can be appointed to the Board of the Placement Service under section 9(1)(f). The person must be a Kenyan citizen with a degree from a university recognized in Kenya. They must also have at least six years' experience in business, financial management, governance or other relevant professional work, and meet the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution (on leadership and integrity).
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 11 kinaeleza ni nani anaweza kuteuliwa kuwa mjumbe wa Bodi ya Huduma ya Upangaji chini ya kifungu cha 9(1)(f). Mtu huyo lazima awe raia wa Kenya na awe na shahada kutoka chuo kikuu kinachotambuliwa nchini Kenya. Pia lazima awe na uzoefu wa angalau miaka sita katika biashara, usimamizi wa fedha, uongozi au kazi nyingine ya kitaaluma inayohusika, na atimize masharti ya Sura ya Sita ya Katiba (kuhusu uongozi na uadilifu).
explanation.sheng: Section 11 ina-set requirements za ku-be appointed member wa Board ya Placement Service under section 9(1)(f). Person must be citizen wa Kenya na awe na degree from university recognized in Kenya. Pia must awe na at least six years experience kwa business, financial management, governance ama other relevant professional work, na ku-meet requirements za Chapter Six ya Constitution (leadership na integrity).

neutral_check.note: Describes the listed qualifications only, with no opinion on them and no view on the Constitution.

clauses.heading: Vacancy of office.
clauses.text: 12. (1) The office of the Chairperson or a member of the Board shall become vacant if the Chairperson or a member– (a) resigns by notice in writing addressed to the appointing authority; (b) is absent from three consecutive meetings of the Board without the permission of the Chairperson or in the case of the Chairperson the permission of the Cabinet Secretary; (c) is unable to exercise the function of the office by reason of physical or mental infirmity; (d) is adjudged bankrupt by a court of competent jurisdiction or enters into a composition or scheme of arrangement for the benefit of creditors; (e) is in breach of the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution; or (f) is convicted of an offence and sentenced to imprisonment for a period of six or more months.

explanation.en: This section lists when the office of the Chairperson or a member of the Board becomes vacant. It happens if they resign in writing to the appointing authority, miss three meetings in a row without permission, or cannot do the job because of physical or mental illness. It also happens if a court declares them bankrupt or they make an arrangement with their creditors, if they breach the Chapter Six requirements of the Constitution, or if they are convicted and sentenced to six months or more in prison. Permission to miss a meeting comes from the Chairperson, and for the Chairperson it comes from the Cabinet Secretary.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaorodhesha hali ambazo nafasi ya Mwenyekiti au mjumbe wa Bodi inakuwa wazi. Nafasi inakuwa wazi akijiuzulu kwa notisi ya maandishi kwa mamlaka ya uteuzi, akikosa mikutano mitatu mfululizo ya Bodi bila ruhusa, au akishindwa kutekeleza majukumu kwa sababu ya ugonjwa wa mwili au akili. Pia inakuwa wazi mahakama ikimtangaza kuwa mfilisi au akiingia makubaliano na wadai wake, akikiuka masharti ya Sura ya Sita ya Katiba, au akihukumiwa kifungo cha miezi sita au zaidi kwa kosa. Ruhusa ya kukosa mkutano hutolewa na Mwenyekiti, na kwa Mwenyekiti hutolewa na Waziri (Cabinet Secretary).
explanation.sheng: Section 12 ina-list when office ya Chairperson ama member wa Board inakuwa vacant. Office inakuwa vacant kama person ana-resign kwa written notice kwa appointing authority, ana-miss three meetings in a row without permission, ama ana-fail ku-do job ya office because ya physical ama mental illness. Pia inakuwa vacant kama court inam-declare bankrupt ama anafanya arrangement na creditors, ana-breach requirements za Chapter Six ya Constitution, ama ni convicted na sentenced to six months ama more in prison. Permission ya ku-miss meeting inatoka kwa Chairperson, na kwa Chairperson inatoka kwa Cabinet Secretary.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the listed grounds for a vacancy on the Board, with no opinion, advice or legal judgement.

clauses.heading: Conduct of business and affairs of the Board.
clauses.text: 13. The provisions of the Schedule shall apply with respect to the conduct of the business and affairs of the Board of the Placement Service.

explanation.en: Section 13 says that the rules in the Schedule to the Bill apply to how the Board of the Placement Service runs its business and affairs. It does not set out those rules itself. It only points to the Schedule for them.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 13 kinasema kwamba masharti ya Jedwali la Mswada yanatumika katika uendeshaji wa shughuli na masuala ya Bodi ya Placement Service. Kifungu hiki hakiweki masharti hayo chenyewe, kinaelekeza tu kwenye Jedwali.
explanation.sheng: Section 13 ina-say kwamba provisions za Schedule zina-apply kwa jinsi Board ya Placement Service ina-run business na affairs zake. Hii section haina-add rules zingine, ina-point tu kwa Schedule.

neutral_check.note: The section only points to the Schedule for how the Board runs its business, so the explanation just says that without any opinion.

clauses.heading: Committees of the Board.
clauses.text: 14. The Board may establish such committees as may be appropriate to perform such functions and discharge such responsibilities as it may determine.

explanation.en: This section lets the Board set up committees whenever it considers them appropriate. The Board itself decides what functions and responsibilities each committee will have.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaruhusu Bodi kuanzisha kamati inazoona zinafaa. Bodi yenyewe ndiyo huamua kazi na majukumu ambayo kila kamati itakuwa nayo.
explanation.sheng: Section 14 ina-allow Board ku-set up committees zozote ambazo ni appropriate. Board yenyewe ndio ina-decide functions na responsibilities za kila committee.

neutral_check.note: The section only concerns how the Board organises itself, so a plain description of its power to create committees kept the explanation neutral.

clauses.heading: Delegation.
clauses.text: 15. The Board may delegate to any committee of the Board or to any member, staff or agent of the Placement Service, the exercise of any of the powers or the performance of any of the functions or duties of the Authority under this Act or any other written law.

explanation.en: Section 15 lets the Board hand over some of its work to others. The Board may delegate any power, function or duty of the Authority under this Act or any other written law. It can delegate to one of its committees, or to a member, staff member or agent of the Placement Service. To delegate means to authorise someone else to act on the Board's behalf.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 15 kinaruhusu Bodi kukabidhi baadhi ya kazi zake kwa wengine. Bodi inaweza kukabidhi mamlaka yoyote, kazi yoyote au wajibu wowote wa Mamlaka chini ya Sheria hii au sheria nyingine yoyote iliyoandikwa. Inaweza kukabidhi kwa kamati yoyote ya Bodi, au kwa mwanachama, mfanyakazi au wakala wa Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service). Kukabidhi kunamaanisha kumruhusu mwingine kutenda kwa niaba ya Bodi.
explanation.sheng: Section 15 ina-allow Board ku-delegate powers, functions na duties za Authority under hii Act ama any other written law. Board inaweza ku-delegate kwa any committee ya Board, ama kwa member, staff ama agent wa Placement Service. Ku-delegate ina-mean ku-authorise someone else ku-act on behalf ya Board.

neutral_check.note: Section only describes an internal power of delegation within a government body; explained without opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Chief Executive Officer.
clauses.text: 16. (1) There shall be a Chief Executive Officer appointed by the Board through an open, transparent, and competitive process. (2) The Chief Executive Officer shall hold office for a term of four years on such terms and conditions of service as the Board may determine and shall be eligible for reappointment for one further term.

explanation.en: This section creates the post of Chief Executive Officer (CEO). The Board appoints the CEO through an open, transparent and competitive process. The CEO serves for four years on terms and conditions of service that the Board decides, and can be reappointed for one more term only.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 16 kinaweka nafasi ya Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji (CEO). Bodi inamteua Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji kupitia mchakato wa wazi, wenye uwazi na ushindani. Anahudumu kwa muda wa miaka minne kwa masharti ya huduma ambayo Bodi inaamua, na anaweza kuteuliwa tena kwa muhula mmoja zaidi tu.
explanation.sheng: Section 16 ina-provide kwa Chief Executive Officer (CEO), ambaye Board ina-appoint kupitia open, transparent na competitive process. CEO anakaa office for four years, kwa terms and conditions ambazo Board ina-decide, na anaweza ku-be reappointed kwa one more term tu.

neutral_check.note: Section only sets out how the CEO is appointed, the term of office and reappointment limit; described without opinion.

clauses.heading: Qualification for appointment as Chief Executive Officer.
clauses.text: 17. (1) A person qualifies to be appointed as a Chief Executive Officer of the Placement Service if the person— (a) holds a bachelor's degree from a university recognized in Kenya; (b) holds a master’s degree in finance, education, social science, or other relevant master’s degree from a university recognized in Kenya; (c) has at least ten years' experience in the management in a public or private institution; and (d) meets the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution.

explanation.en: Section 17 sets out who can be appointed Chief Executive Officer of the Placement Service. The person needs a bachelor's degree and a master's degree (in finance, education, social science or another relevant field), both from universities recognised in Kenya. They also need at least ten years of management experience in a public or private institution, and must meet the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution (the chapter on leadership and integrity).
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 17 kinaeleza sifa za mtu kuteuliwa kuwa Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji wa Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service). Mtu huyo anahitaji shahada ya kwanza na shahada ya uzamili katika fedha, elimu, sayansi ya jamii au fani nyingine husika, zote kutoka chuo kikuu kinachotambuliwa nchini Kenya. Pia anahitaji uzoefu wa angalau miaka kumi katika usimamizi wa taasisi ya umma au ya binafsi, na kutimiza masharti ya Sura ya Sita ya Katiba (kuhusu uongozi na uadilifu).
explanation.sheng: Section 17 ina-list qualifications za kuwa appointed Chief Executive Officer (CEO) wa Placement Service. Person ana-need bachelor's degree na master's degree in finance, education, social science ama other relevant field, both from university recognized in Kenya. Ana-need pia at least ten years' experience ya management kwa public ama private institution, na ku-meet requirements za Chapter Six ya Constitution (leadership na integrity).

neutral_check.note: Section only lists appointment qualifications for a government body's CEO; described without opinion, advice or legal judgement.

clauses.heading: Vacancy in the office of the Chief Executive Officer.
clauses.text: 18. (1) The office of the Chief Executive Officer may become vacant if the holder of the office resigns or is removed from office in accordance with subsection (2). (2) The Chief Executive Officer may be removed from office if the Chief Executive Officer is— (a) in breach of chapter six of the Constitution; (b) adjudged bankrupt or enters into a composition scheme or arrangement with his or her creditors; (c) incapacitated by physical or mental illness; or (d) is convicted of a criminal offence and sentenced to imprisonment for a term exceeding six months;

explanation.en: Section 18 says when the office of the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) becomes vacant. This can happen if the CEO resigns or is removed from office. The CEO can be removed on four grounds: breaching chapter six of the Constitution (the chapter on leadership and integrity), being declared bankrupt or making an arrangement with creditors, being unable to work because of physical or mental illness, or being convicted of a crime and sentenced to prison for more than six months.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 18 kinaeleza wakati ambapo nafasi ya Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji inakuwa wazi. Hali hii inaweza kutokea akijiuzulu au akiondolewa ofisini. Anaweza kuondolewa kwa sababu nne: kukiuka Sura ya Sita ya Katiba (kuhusu uongozi na uadilifu), kutangazwa kufilisika au kufanya mapatano na wadai wake, kushindwa kufanya kazi kwa sababu ya ugonjwa wa mwili au akili, au kuhukumiwa kifungo cha zaidi ya miezi sita kwa kosa la jinai.
explanation.sheng: Section 18 ina-explain lini office ya Chief Executive Officer (CEO) inakuwa vacant. Hii inaweza ku-happen kama CEO ana-resign ama ana-get removed from office. CEO anaweza ku-get removed kwa four reasons: ku-breach chapter six ya Constitution (ile ya leadership na integrity), ku-declared bankrupt ama ku-make arrangement na creditors wake, ku-fail kufanya kazi kwa sababu ya physical ama mental illness, ama ku-convicted ya crime na kupewa prison term ya zaidi ya six months.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the conditions for a vacancy and the grounds for removal, with no opinion, advice or legal verdict.

clauses.heading: Staff of the Placement Service.
clauses.text: 19. The Board may appoint such staff as may be necessary for the proper discharge of the functions of the Service.

explanation.en: This section lets the Board appoint staff for the Placement Service. The Board can appoint the staff it needs for the Service to carry out its functions properly. The section does not say how many staff there will be or what jobs they will do.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 19 kinaruhusu Bodi kuteua wafanyakazi wa Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service). Bodi inaweza kuteua wafanyakazi wanaohitajika ili Huduma itekeleze majukumu yake ipasavyo. Kifungu hiki hakisemi idadi ya wafanyakazi wala kazi watakazofanya.
explanation.sheng: Section 19 ina-let Board ku-hire staff wa Placement Service kama wanahitajika kwa work ya Service. Hii section haisemi staff watakuwa wangapi wala jobs watakazofanya.

neutral_check.note: Short administrative section about the Board hiring staff; described plainly with no opinion or advice.

clauses.heading: Placement Service obligation.
clauses.text: 20. (1) The Placement Service shall conduct placement of all students who apply and are eligible to undertake tertiary education in a public tertiary institution. (2) The Placement Service shall maintain, update, and publicize a list of all accredited public tertiary institutions submitted by regulatory bodies for purposes of placement of students in accordance with this Act. (3) Despite subsection (1) and (2), the Placement Service may place an eligible student to a private tertiary institution upon request by a student and where there exists no vacancy for the eligible student to pursue the proposed course or programme in a public tertiary institution (4) The Placement Service shall develop a placement framework to guide the placement process. (5) Funding under this Act shall be for students who have been placed by the Placement Service.

explanation.en: Section 20 sets out what the Placement Service must do. It places all eligible students who apply for tertiary education in public tertiary institutions, and it keeps, updates and publishes a list of accredited public institutions sent to it by regulators. It may place an eligible student in a private institution only if the student asks and there is no vacancy in a public institution for that course or programme. It must also develop a placement framework, and funding under this Act is only for students the Placement Service has placed.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 20 kinaeleza majukumu ya Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service). Huduma hiyo inapanga wanafunzi wote wanaostahili na walioomba elimu ya juu katika taasisi za umma, na inatunza, kusasisha na kutangaza orodha ya taasisi za umma zilizoidhinishwa zinazowasilishwa na mashirika ya udhibiti. Inaweza kumpanga mwanafunzi anayestahili katika taasisi ya kibinafsi ikiwa mwanafunzi ameomba na hakuna nafasi katika taasisi ya umma kwa kozi au programu hiyo. Pia inaandaa mfumo wa upangaji, na ufadhili chini ya Sheria hii ni kwa wanafunzi waliopangwa na Huduma hiyo.
explanation.sheng: Section 20 ina-set out obligations za Placement Service. Placement Service ina-place all students ambao wana-apply na ni eligible kwa tertiary education kwa public tertiary institution, na ina-keep, ina-update na ku-publish list ya accredited public tertiary institutions kutoka kwa regulatory bodies. Ina-place eligible student kwa private tertiary institution tu kama student ame-request na hakuna vacancy kwa public institution kwa hio course ama programme. Pia ina-develop placement framework, na funding under hii Act ni ya students ambao Placement Service ime-place.

neutral_check.note: Describes the Placement Service duties and the link between placement and funding without opinion, advice or any judgement on legality.

clauses.heading: Submission of programmes, capacity and costs by public tertiary institutions.
clauses.text: 21. (1) Every public tertiary institution shall, at least two months before the release of the national assessment results, submit to the Placement Service the— (a) programmes to be offered; (b) capacity of each programme; and (c) approved cost of each programme. (2) The Placement Service shall validate the information submitted under subsection (1) in consultation with the regulatory bodies. (3) The Placement Service shall, on completion of validation, publicize the programmes, the capacity of each programme and the costs in the Placement Service’s portal.

explanation.en: Section 21 requires every public tertiary institution to send the Placement Service three things: the programmes it will offer, how many students each programme can take, and the approved cost of each programme. This must be done at least two months before the national assessment results are released. The Placement Service then checks the information together with the regulatory bodies. Once the checking is complete, it publishes the programmes, their capacity and their costs on its portal.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 21 kinazitaka taasisi zote za umma za elimu ya juu kuwasilisha kwa Placement Service programu zitakazotolewa, uwezo wa kila programu na gharama iliyoidhinishwa ya kila programu. Taarifa hizi zinawasilishwa angalau miezi miwili kabla ya matokeo ya tathmini ya kitaifa kutolewa. Placement Service inahakiki taarifa hizo pamoja na mashirika ya udhibiti. Baada ya kukamilisha uhakiki, inachapisha programu, uwezo wa kila programu na gharama kwenye tovuti yake.
explanation.sheng: Section 21 ina-require kila public tertiary institution ku-submit kwa Placement Service: programmes ambazo zitakuwa offered, capacity ya kila programme, na approved cost ya kila programme. Hii ina-happen at least two months kabla ya national assessment results ku-be released. Placement Service ina-validate hio info na regulatory bodies, na ikimaliza validation ina-publish programmes, capacity na costs kwa portal yake.

neutral_check.note: Described only the submission, validation and publishing steps and the timing, with no opinion on the process.

clauses.heading: Application and determination of placement.
clauses.text: 22. (1) The Placement Service shall, within thirty days of the release of the national assessment results, invite applications for placement. (2) The Placement Service shall, within thirty days of receipt of the application process the applications and communicate its decision to the applicants and the tertiary institutions. (3) In processing the applicantions under subsection (2), the Authority shall be guided by the placement framework.

explanation.en: This section sets time limits for placing students in tertiary institutions (colleges and universities). The Placement Service has thirty days after the national assessment results are released to invite applications. After it receives an application, it has thirty days to process it and tell both the applicants and the tertiary institutions its decision. Subsection (3) says the Authority is guided by the placement framework when processing the applications.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaweka muda wa kuwapangia wanafunzi nafasi katika taasisi za elimu ya juu. Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service) ina siku 30 baada ya matokeo ya tathmini ya kitaifa kutolewa kualika maombi. Baada ya kupokea ombi, ina siku 30 kulishughulikia na kuwajulisha waombaji na taasisi za elimu ya juu uamuzi wake. Kifungu kidogo cha (3) kinasema Mamlaka (Authority) huongozwa na mfumo wa upangaji (placement framework) wakati wa kushughulikia maombi.
explanation.sheng: Section 22 ina-set timelines za placement ya students kwa tertiary institutions. Placement Service iko na within thirty days baada ya national assessment results kuwa released ku-invite applications. Baada ya ku-receive application, iko na within thirty days ku-process hio application na ku-communicate decision kwa applicants na tertiary institutions. Kwa ku-process applications, Authority ina-follow placement framework.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the timelines and who is informed. Subsection (3) names the Authority while subsections (1) and (2) name the Placement Service, and the explanation follows the text as written.

clauses.heading: Revision of application for placement.
clauses.text: 23. (1) An applicant whose application for placement under section 22 is unsuccessful shall be accorded an opportunity to revise the application without charge. (2) A person who did not make an application under section 22 shall have a second opportunity to make a placement application under this section subject to payment of the requisite fees. (3) The Placement Service shall invite applicants under subsection (1) and (2) to revise or make their application within fifteen days from the date of invitation. (4) The Placement Service shall, within fifteen days process the applications and communicate its decision to the applicants and tertiary institutions.

explanation.en: This section gives an applicant whose placement application under section 22 was unsuccessful a chance to revise it, free of charge. A person who did not apply under section 22 gets a second chance to apply, and must pay the required fees. The Placement Service invites both groups, who then have fifteen days from the date of invitation to revise or make their application. After that, the Placement Service has fifteen days to process the applications and tell the applicants and the tertiary institutions its decision.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinawapa waombaji ambao maombi yao ya upangaji (placement) chini ya Kifungu cha 22 hayakufanikiwa nafasi ya kurekebisha maombi hayo bila malipo. Mtu ambaye hakuwasilisha ombi chini ya Kifungu cha 22 anapewa nafasi ya pili ya kuomba, kwa kulipa ada zinazohitajika. Placement Service huwaalika makundi yote mawili, nao wana siku kumi na tano kuanzia tarehe ya mwaliko kurekebisha ama kuwasilisha maombi yao. Kisha Placement Service ina siku kumi na tano kushughulikia maombi na kuwajulisha waombaji na taasisi za elimu ya juu uamuzi wake.
explanation.sheng: Section 23 ina-give applicants ambao application yao ya placement haikuwa successful chance ya ku-revise application bila charge. Person ambaye hakufanya application under section 22 anapata second chance ya ku-apply, lakini ana-pay required fees. Placement Service ina-invite hao applicants, nao wana fifteen days from date ya invitation ku-revise ama ku-apply. Baada ya hapo, Placement Service ina-process applications within fifteen days na ku-tell applicants na tertiary institutions decision yake.

neutral_check.note: Describes the revision and second application process, the fees and the fifteen-day periods, with no opinion, advice or legal verdict.

clauses.heading: Placement Report.
clauses.text: 24. (1) The Placement Service shall, on completion of the placement process, submit the placement report to the Cabinet Secretary. (2) The placement report shall contain information on the placement of students in tertiary institutions and where the provisions of section 20(3) apply, the report shall include information— (a) on the number of students placed in private tertiary institutions; (b) on the courses to be undertaken by the eligible students; and (c) specifying how the requirements under section 20(3) have been met.

explanation.en: Section 24 requires the Placement Service to send the placement report to the Cabinet Secretary once the placement process is complete. The report must give information on how students were placed in tertiary institutions. Where section 20(3) applies, the report must also give the number of students placed in private tertiary institutions, the courses the eligible students will take, and how the requirements of section 20(3) were met.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 24 kinaitaka Placement Service (Huduma ya Upangaji wa Wanafunzi) kuwasilisha ripoti ya upangaji kwa Waziri (Cabinet Secretary) baada ya mchakato wa upangaji kukamilika. Ripoti hiyo lazima iwe na taarifa kuhusu upangaji wa wanafunzi katika taasisi za elimu ya juu. Pale kifungu kidogo cha 20(3) kinapotumika, ripoti pia lazima ionyeshe idadi ya wanafunzi waliopangiwa taasisi za kibinafsi, kozi watakazosoma wanafunzi wanaostahili, na jinsi masharti ya kifungu kidogo cha 20(3) yalivyotimizwa.
explanation.sheng: Section 24 ina-require Placement Service ku-submit placement report kwa Cabinet Secretary baada ya placement process ku-complete. Report iko na information ya placement ya students kwa tertiary institutions. Kama section 20(3) ina-apply, report pia ina-include number ya students placed kwa private tertiary institutions, courses ambazo eligible students wata-take, na how requirements za section 20(3) zili-met.

neutral_check.note: Describes a reporting duty between the Placement Service and the Cabinet Secretary, with no opinion, advice or legal judgement.

clauses.heading: Transfers.
clauses.text: 25. (1) A student or trainee who has been placed in a programme may apply to the institution to change the programme or the institution. (2) Every tertiary institution shall submit to the Placement Service any inter institutional and inter faculty transfer in its institution within fifteen days of the transfer.

explanation.en: A student or trainee who has already been placed in a programme can apply to the institution to change to another programme or another institution. The section also requires every tertiary institution to report each transfer between institutions or between faculties to the Placement Service within fifteen days of the transfer.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinamruhusu mwanafunzi au mwanagenzi aliyepangiwa programu kuomba kwa taasisi kubadilisha programu au taasisi. Pia, kila taasisi ya elimu ya juu inatakiwa kuwasilisha kwa Placement Service uhamisho wowote kati ya taasisi au kati ya vitivo ndani ya siku kumi na tano baada ya uhamisho.
explanation.sheng: Section 25 ina-allow student ama trainee ambaye ali-placed kwa programme ku-apply kwa institution ili ku-change programme ama institution. Pia kila tertiary institution inatakiwa ku-submit kwa Placement Service kila inter institutional na inter faculty transfer ndani ya fifteen days baada ya transfer.

neutral_check.note: Describes the right to apply for a transfer and the institution's reporting duty without opinion, advice or any judgement on legality.

clauses.heading: Institution admission returns.
clauses.text: 26. (1) All tertiary institutions shall submit to the Placement Service returns on the particulars of students enrolled in respective programmes within thirty days after the commencement of the tertiary institution’s academic year. (2) A person who contravenes the provisions of this section commits an offence.

explanation.en: Every tertiary institution (a college or university) must send the Placement Service a return listing the students enrolled in each of its programmes. The return is due within thirty days after the institution's academic year begins. A person who breaks this section commits an offence.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki cha 26 kinataka taasisi zote za elimu ya juu ziwasilishe marejesho kwa Placement Service yenye maelezo ya wanafunzi waliosajiliwa katika kila programu. Marejesho hayo yawasilishwe ndani ya siku thelathini baada ya mwaka wa masomo wa taasisi kuanza. Mtu anayekiuka kifungu hiki anatenda kosa.
explanation.sheng: Section 26 ina-require tertiary institutions zote ku-submit returns kwa Placement Service na details za students wana-enroll kwa kila programme. Hizo returns ni due within thirty days baada ya academic year ya institution ku-start. Kama person ana-break hii section, anafanya offence.

neutral_check.note: Describes only the duty on institutions to submit returns, the deadline and the offence, with no opinion, advice or legal verdict.

clauses.heading: Career guidance programmes.
clauses.text: 27. (1) The Placement Service shall develop and implement career guidance programmes to persons intending to pursue tertiary education in tertiary institutions. (2) In developing the career guidelines programme, the Placement Service may— (a) conduct market surveys to identify labour market demands and required skills; (b) collect and analyse relevant data on career choices and trends; (c) collaborate with other relevant government agencies and stakeholders; and (d) benchmark on international best practices. (3) The Placement Service may implement the career guidance programmes contemplated under subsection (1) either on its own, through accredited institutions or persons or in collaboration, with other relevant government agencies and stakeholders. (4) In implementing the career guidance programmes contemplated under subsection (1), the Placement Service may– (a) conduct career guidance fairs, exhibitions and conferences and such other stakeholder forums; (b) conduct continuous training of career mentors; (c) develop career guidance manuals, publications, documentaries, social media content, books and other information education and communication materials; and (d) disseminate research findings and information on career guidance.

explanation.en: Section 27 requires the Placement Service to develop and run career guidance programmes for people who plan to join tertiary institutions (colleges and universities). While designing them, it may do market surveys on job and skill demand, collect data on career choices, work with other government agencies and stakeholders, and learn from international practice. It may run the programmes itself, through accredited institutions or persons, or together with others. It may also hold career fairs and forums, train career mentors, produce guides, documentaries and social media content, and share research on career guidance.
explanation.sw: Kifungu cha 27 kinaitaka Huduma ya Upangaji (Placement Service) kuandaa na kutekeleza programu za ushauri wa taaluma kwa watu wanaokusudia kujiunga na taasisi za elimu ya juu (vyuo na vyuo vikuu). Katika kuziandaa, inaweza kufanya tafiti za soko la ajira, kukusanya data kuhusu uchaguzi wa taaluma, kushirikiana na mashirika mengine ya serikali na wadau, na kujifunza kutoka kwa mbinu bora za kimataifa. Inaweza kuzitekeleza yenyewe, kupitia taasisi au watu walioidhinishwa, au kwa ushirikiano na wengine. Pia inaweza kuandaa maonyesho na kongamano za ushauri wa taaluma, kuwafunza washauri wa taaluma, kutayarisha miongozo, makala za video na maudhui ya mitandao ya kijamii, na kusambaza matokeo ya utafiti.
explanation.sheng: Section 27 ina-require Placement Service ku-develop na ku-run career guidance programmes kwa persons ambao wanapanga ku-join tertiary institutions (colleges na universities). Wakati wa ku-design, inaweza ku-do market surveys kuhusu job demand na skills, ku-collect data ya career choices, ku-work na other government agencies na stakeholders, na ku-learn from international best practices. Placement Service inaweza ku-implement programmes yenyewe, through accredited institutions ama persons, ama together na other stakeholders. Pia inaweza ku-hold career fairs na forums, ku-train career mentors, ku-make guides, documentaries na social media content, na ku-share research on career guidance.

neutral_check.note: Described only what the Placement Service must or may do, with no opinion, advice or legal judgment.

clauses.heading: Establishment of the Authority.
clauses.text: 28. (1) There is established an Authority to be known as the Tertiary Education Funding Authority. (2) The Authority shall be a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal and shall, in its corporate name, be capable of— (a) suing and being sued; (b) taking, purchasing, or otherwise acquiring, holding, charging, leasing, or disposing of moveable or immovable property; (c) borrowing and lending money; (d) doing or performing all such other acts necessary for the proper performance of its functions under this Act which may lawfully be done or performed by a body corporate. (3) The headquarters of the Authority shall be in Nairobi but the Authority shall ensure access to its services in all parts of Kenya.

explanation.en: This section creates a new body called the Tertiary Education Funding Authority. It is a legal entity in its own right (a body corporate): it carries on even if its members change, has an official seal, and can sue and be sued in its own name. It can own, buy, lease, charge or sell property, borrow and lend money, and do other lawful acts needed for its work under the Act. Its headquarters are in Nairobi, and it must make its services available in all parts of Kenya.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaanzisha Mamlaka itakayoitwa Tertiary Education Funding Authority. Mamlaka ni shirika lenye hadhi ya kisheria, linaloendelea kuwepo daima na lenye muhuri wake, na linaweza kushtaki na kushtakiwa kwa jina lake. Linaweza kumiliki, kununua, kukodisha, kuweka rehani au kuuza mali, kukopa na kukopesha pesa, na kufanya mambo mengine halali yanayohitajika kwa kazi zake chini ya Sheria hii. Makao makuu yake yatakuwa Nairobi, na Mamlaka inatakiwa kuhakikisha huduma zake zinapatikana katika sehemu zote za Kenya.
explanation.sheng: Section 28 ina-establish Tertiary Education Funding Authority. Authority ni body corporate, yaani iko na perpetual succession (inaendelea kuwepo hata kama members wanabadilika) na common seal, kwa hio inaweza ku-sue ama ku-be sued kwa name yake. Pia inaweza ku-buy, ku-own, ku-lease ama ku-sell property, na ku-borrow na ku-lend money. Headquarters ziko Nairobi, na Authority inatakiwa ku-ensure services zake zinapatikana in all parts of Kenya.

neutral_check.note: The section only sets up a body corporate and its legal powers and location, so it was described without opinion, advice or any judgement on legality.

clauses.heading: Functions of the Authority.
clauses.text: 29. The Authority shall— (a) mobilise funds for lending to students and trainees pursuing tertiary education; (b) in consultation with the Cabinet Secretary, set funding criteria for students and trainees pursuing tertiary education; (c) grant loans to eligible students and trainees pursuing tertiary education; (d) administer scholarships to eligible students pursuing tertiary education; (e) establish and maintain a system for data management relating to funding of tertiary education; (f) advise the Cabinet Secretary on matters relating to funding of tertiary education; and (g) perform any other function conferred on it by this Act or any other written law.

explanation.en: This section lists what the Authority is responsible for. It raises funds to lend to students and trainees in tertiary education (education after secondary school), and, together with the Cabinet Secretary, sets the criteria for who gets funding. It grants loans to eligible students and trainees, and runs scholarships for eligible students. It also sets up and keeps a data system on tertiary education funding, advises the Cabinet Secretary on funding matters, and does any other function given to it by this Act or another written law.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaorodhesha kazi za Mamlaka (Authority). Mamlaka inakusanya fedha za kukopesha wanafunzi na wanafunzi wa mafunzo (trainees) walio katika elimu ya juu, na kwa kushauriana na Waziri (Cabinet Secretary) inaweka vigezo vya ufadhili. Inatoa mikopo kwa wanafunzi na wanafunzi wa mafunzo wanaostahili, na kusimamia udhamini (scholarships) kwa wanafunzi wanaostahili. Pia inaunda na kudumisha mfumo wa data kuhusu ufadhili wa elimu ya juu, inamshauri Waziri kuhusu masuala ya ufadhili, na kutekeleza kazi nyingine yoyote inayopewa na Sheria hii au sheria nyingine iliyoandikwa.
explanation.sheng: Section 29 ina-list functions za Authority. Authority ina-mobilise funds za ku-lend students na trainees ambao wako kwa tertiary education, na pamoja na Cabinet Secretary ina-set funding criteria. Pia ina-grant loans kwa eligible students na trainees, na ina-administer scholarships kwa eligible students. Authority ina-set up na ku-maintain data system ya funding ya tertiary education, ina-advise Cabinet Secretary kuhusu funding, na ina-perform any other function ambayo hii Act ama another written law ina-give.

neutral_check.note: Section only lists the Authority's functions; explanation describes each item without opinion, advice or judgement.

clauses.heading: Powers of the Authority.
clauses.text: 30. In performance of the functions under section 29, the Authority shall have powers to– (a) manage and administer loans; (b) administer the assets of the Authority; (c) recover loans from loan beneficiaries; (d) in consultation with the Cabinet Secretary, set the interest rate for loans; (e) open and operate bank accounts in accordance with the relevant laws; (f) receive any gifts, grants, donations, endowments, or any other monies lawfully received by the Authority; (g) mobilise resources from treasury bills, bonds, concessional loans, Government grants, savings scheme, unit trusts, commercial partners, loans repayments and any other lawful source for purposes of the Act; (h) mobilize private capital and non-traditional sources of educational finance including domestic pension funds and collective investment schemes, sovereign wealth funds or climate finance; (i) establish a savings scheme or product to receive deposits from any person for the purpose of saving towards tertiary education in respect of a specific child; (j) enter into associations, collaborations and linkages with other persons, bodies, or organizations within or outside Kenya, as the Authority may consider appropriate; and (k) enter and inspect business premises and employers for compliance.

explanation.en: In carrying out its functions under section 29, the Authority has these powers: to manage and administer loans, to administer its own assets, and to recover loans from the people who received them. It sets the loan interest rate in consultation with the Cabinet Secretary. It can open and run bank accounts under the relevant laws, and receive gifts, grants, donations, endowments and other money lawfully given to it. It can raise money from treasury bills, bonds, concessional loans (loans on softer terms), Government grants, savings schemes, unit trusts, commercial partners, loan repayments and any other lawful source. It can also raise private capital and non-traditional education finance, such as domestic pension funds, collective investment schemes, sovereign wealth funds or climate finance. It can set up a savings scheme or product that takes deposits from any person to save towards tertiary education for a specific child, and enter into partnerships with other bodies in or outside Kenya. Lastly, it can enter and inspect business premises and employers to check compliance.
explanation.sw: Katika kutekeleza majukumu yake chini ya Kifungu cha 29, Mamlaka ina mamlaka ya kusimamia na kuendesha mikopo, kusimamia mali yake, na kukusanya mikopo kutoka kwa wanaonufaika nayo. Inaweka kiwango cha riba ya mikopo kwa kushauriana na Waziri. Inaweza kufungua na kuendesha akaunti za benki kwa mujibu wa sheria husika, na kupokea zawadi, ruzuku, michango, hazina za msaada na fedha nyingine zilizotolewa kisheria. Inaweza kukusanya rasilimali kutoka hati fungani za serikali, dhamana, mikopo nafuu, ruzuku za Serikali, mipango ya akiba, hazina za uwekezaji, washirika wa kibiashara, marejesho ya mikopo na chanzo kingine chochote halali. Pia inaweza kukusanya mtaji wa kibinafsi na vyanzo visivyo vya kawaida vya ufadhili wa elimu, kama vile hazina za pensheni za ndani, mipango ya uwekezaji wa pamoja, hazina za utajiri za mataifa au ufadhili wa tabianchi. Inaweza kuanzisha mpango au bidhaa ya akiba inayopokea amana kutoka kwa mtu yeyote kwa ajili ya elimu ya juu ya mtoto maalum, na kushirikiana na taasisi nyingine ndani au nje ya Kenya. Mwisho, inaweza kuingia na kukagua majengo ya biashara na waajiri ili kuhakikisha utiifu.
explanation.sheng: Section 30 ina-list powers za Authority kwa functions zake chini ya section 29. Authority ina-manage na ku-administer loans, ina-handle assets zake, na ina-recover loans kutoka kwa loan beneficiaries. Ina-set interest rate ya loans pamoja na Cabinet Secretary, ina-open na ku-operate bank accounts under the relevant laws, na ina-receive gifts, grants, donations, endowments na other money lawfully given to it. Pia ina-raise money kutoka treasury bills, bonds, concessional loans (loans za softer terms), Government grants, savings scheme, unit trusts, commercial partners, loan repayments na any other lawful source. Ina-mobilize private capital na non-traditional sources of education finance kama domestic pension funds, collective investment schemes, sovereign wealth funds ama climate finance. Authority inaweza ku-establish savings scheme ama product ya ku-receive deposits kutoka kwa any person kwa ajili ya tertiary education ya specific child, na ku-enter partnerships na bodies inside ama outside Kenya. Mwisho, inaweza ku-enter na ku-inspect business premises na employers ku-check compliance.

neutral_check.note: Lists the Authority's powers one by one in plain words, with no opinion on them and no advice.

clauses.heading: Board of the Authority.
clauses.text: 31. (1) There shall be a Board of Authority which shall consist of– (a) a Chairperson, who shall be appointed by the President; (b) the Principal Secretary responsible for matters relating to university education or a designated representative; (c) the Principal Secretary responsible for matters relating to technical and vocational education and training or a designated representative; (d) the Principal Secretary responsible for matters relating to finance or a designated representative; (e) the Attorney-General or a designated representative; (f) four persons who shall not be public officers; and (g) the Chief Executive Officer who shall be an ex officio member with no voting rights. (2) The members of the Board appointed under subsection (1) (f) shall be appointed by the Cabinet Secretary by notice in the Gazette. (3) The Chairperson and members of the Board appointed under subsection (1) (a) and (f) shall hold office for a term of three years and shall be eligible for reappointment for one further term of three years subject to satisfactory performance.

explanation.en: This section sets up the Board of the Authority. It is made up of a Chairperson appointed by the President, three Principal Secretaries (university education, technical and vocational education and training, and finance) and the Attorney-General, each of whom may send a designated representative, four members who are not public officers, and the Chief Executive Officer, who is a member but cannot vote. The Cabinet Secretary appoints the four non-public-officer members by notice in the Gazette (the official government notice). The Chairperson and those four members serve for three years and can be reappointed once for another three years, subject to satisfactory performance.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaunda Bodi ya Mamlaka. Bodi hiyo ina Mwenyekiti anayeteuliwa na Rais, Makatibu Wakuu watatu (elimu ya vyuo vikuu, mafunzo ya ufundi na kiufundi, na fedha) na Mwanasheria Mkuu, ambao kila mmoja anaweza kuwakilishwa na mtu aliyeteuliwa, watu wanne ambao si maafisa wa umma, na Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji ambaye ni mjumbe bila haki ya kupiga kura. Waziri huteua wajumbe hao wanne kupitia tangazo katika Gazeti Rasmi la Serikali. Mwenyekiti na wajumbe hao wanne wanahudumu kwa miaka mitatu, na wanaweza kuteuliwa tena mara moja kwa miaka mitatu mingine, kulingana na utendaji wa kuridhisha.
explanation.sheng: Section 31 ina-set up Board ya Authority. Board iko na Chairperson ambaye President ana-appoint, three Principal Secretaries (university education, technical and vocational training, na finance), Attorney-General, na four members ambao si public officers, na kila Principal Secretary na Attorney-General anaweza kutuma designated representative. Chief Executive Officer ni member lakini hana vote. Cabinet Secretary ana-appoint hao four members kupitia notice kwa Gazette, na Chairperson na hao four members wana-serve three years, kisha wanaweza kupewa another term moja ya three years kama performance yao ni satisfactory.

neutral_check.note: Describes only who sits on the Board, who appoints them and their terms, with no opinion, advice or legal verdict.

clauses.heading: Qualifications of the Chairperson of the Board.
clauses.text: 32. A person qualifies to be appointed as the Chairperson of the Board under section 31 (1) (a), if the person— (a) is a citizen of Kenya; (b) holds a degree from a university recognized in Kenya; (c) has at least ten years’ experience in resource mobilization, business, financial management, governance, or other relevant professional experience; and (d) meets the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution.

explanation.en: This section lists what a person needs to be appointed Chairperson of the Board under section 31 (1) (a). The person must be a Kenyan citizen and hold a degree from a university recognized in Kenya. They must also have at least ten years' experience in resource mobilization, business, financial management, governance or other relevant professional work, and meet the requirements of Chapter Six of the Constitution.
explanation.sw: Kifungu hiki kinaeleza sifa za mtu kuteuliwa kuwa Mwenyekiti wa Bodi chini ya kifungu cha 31 (1) (a). Mtu huyo anapaswa kuwa raia wa Kenya na kuwa na shahada kutoka chuo kikuu kinachotambuliwa nchini Kenya. Pia anapaswa kuwa na uzoefu wa angalau miaka kumi katika kuchangisha rasilimali, biashara, usimamizi wa fedha, uongozi au taaluma nyingine husika, na kutimiza masharti ya Sura ya Sita ya Katiba.
explanation.sheng: Section 32 ina-list requirements za person ku-qualify kama Chairperson wa Board under section 31 (1) (a). Person anatakiwa kuwa citizen wa Kenya, ana-hold degree from university recognized in Kenya, na ana at least ten years' experience in resource mobilization, business, financial management, governance ama other relevant professional work. Pia anatakiwa ku-meet requirements za Chapter Six ya Constitution.

neutral_check.note: The section only sets out appointment qualifications for a board chairperson, and the explanation describes them without opinion, advice or any view on validity.

clauses.heading: Qualification of a member of the Board.
clauses.text: 33.
